tabs.tab2_heading: Who should wear Green Tourmaline gemstone?
tabs.tab1_description:
Green Tourmaline gemstone is perhaps Nature's best healing gemstone of the physical heart, channeling its electrical energies into the center of one's being and creating a flow of healthy energy to all parts of the body and self. It is the masculine or yang counterpart to Pink Tourmaline's feminine heart energies and enhances courage, strength, stamina, and vitality. Its spiritual vibrations harmonize with the Earth's energies as it activates a strong resonance with Divine Love and opens the Heart Chakra.

Green Tourmaline has a positive effect on all living and growing things. It can be used in meditation to communicate with Nature spirits and physically connect with plant and animal spirits. It is the most desirable of all green life-giving stones due to its rejuvenating properties. Unlike other green gemstones for the Heart Chakra, green tourmaline stone provides emotional healing based on grounding hence enduring and solid relationships.

One of the most distinguishing characteristics of tourmaline is its ability to turn electrically charged merely by being heated or rubbed. When charged, one end becomes positive and the other becomes negative, enabling it to attract dust or paper particles. This particular property of pyroelectricity (from heating) or piezoelectricity (from pressure or friction) was well-known to Dutch merchants of the 1700s, who used tourmaline to remove ash from Meerschaum pipes, naming the stone Aschentrekker, or "ash puller."

Green Tourmaline enables one to "see with the heart" and experience life's miracles. It promotes an attitude of gratitude and an interest in fellow humans and the environment.

Verdelite gemstone stimulates the emotional body's growth and expansion, allowing to expressing themselves better and less fearful of change. It fosters compassion, sensitivity, and patience, and a sense of belonging.

Green Tourmaline aids in overcoming emotional issues associated with a father figure or other male influences.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although Green Tourmaline gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing it. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Heart Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for cordial and harmonious relationships.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses user with understanding, contentment and unconditional love. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.  

Green Tourmaline heals broken hearts through grounding, so it is recommended for those who have gone through a breakup or divorce in order to restore their emotions, as well as anyone who wishes to have happier relationships. Indeed, the Verdelite gemstone is ideal for anyone with an active social life.

The gemstone is recommended to wear also for those who need a logical thought process, rational thinking and a positive outlook on life or everything around may wear a Green Tourmaline gemstone.

It nullifies the malefic of Mercury as well. Green Tourmaline is ruled by the planet Mercury (Buddha), giving the wearer cleverness, intellect, wit and humor.

Important Details:

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Green Tourmaline gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Green Tourmaline gemstones.

Green Tourmaline Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Green Tourmalines Gems are sometimes called Brazilian emeralds, though the name is a misnomer. Brazil, however, is known for producing the best quality tourmaline gemstones in the world. Green Tourmaline gemstones are found in Sri Lanka, Brazil, Pakistan and several parts of Africa.

Observe their Color:

The color range of green tourmaline is from yellow-green to green to blue-green. As long as green predominates, you got a true verdelite gemstone. If a tourmaline is bluer than it is green, it is an indicolite or blue tourmaline.

Notice their Clarity:

After being cut and polished, green tourmaline gemstone has an extremely alluring vitreous to slightly resinous sheen.

Examine their Inclusions:

The majority of tourmaline gemstones are included and are typically found with visible fractures and needle-like inclusions, but chrome tourmaline is prized for its exceptional transparency and is typically eye-clean with very few inclusions.

See their Shape:

Cushion, round, oval, pear, and triangular (trillion) shapes are common. These shapes tend to maximize color saturation while maximizing rough carat weight. Green tourmaline is typically faceted to enhance its color and brilliance, but it is occasionally cabochon-cut.

Check the Carats:

For Green Tourmaline of gem quality, the raw Green Tourmaline is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Green Tourmaline weighing 4 carats and above is appropriate for jewelry. Because Green Tourmaline is sold by weight, Green Tourmaline prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Green Tourmaline has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Green Tourmaline

Due to treatments the Green Tourmaline stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Green Tourmaline do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate

It is recommended that you should purchase Green Tourmaline gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Green Tourmaline are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Green Tourmaline from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Green Tourmaline gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Green Tourmaline gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Green Tourmaline is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).

Color

Of all the shades of green, the deep green in green tourmalines are regarded as the best.

Cut

Green tourmalines are often fashioned into elegant rectangular shapes holding the maximum weight and energy. You can choose a square, rectangular, or emerald-cut Green Tourmaline as well.

Carat

Green Tourmaline 4 carats and above is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Green Tourmaline are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Green Tourmaline rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Among all the green stones, the green Tourmaline contains lesser inclusions and brilliant luster. However, the green tourmalines with some natural inclusions are accepted.

Traders deal in Green Tourmaline that is synthetic to natural but is treated/heated and color enhanced, so you must buy only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputable lab.

Green Tourmaline Gemstone Price

The price of Green Tourmaline gemstone depends on its size, its cut, as well as its origin in terms of color and clarity. Green Tourmaline stone price is not excessively high, but rather moderate. For making jewelry, Green Tourmaline stone beads, artifacts, and other similar items, the Green Tourmaline stone price per kilogram is economical for all who purchase Green Tourmaline stone at wholesale. Just ensure to buy it untreated.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Green Tourmaline has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Green Tourmaline stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Green Tourmaline gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 4,375 to INR 50,000 (USD 54 to USD 625).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Green Tourmaline?

The best way to check the authenticity of Green Tourmaline is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Green Tourmaline are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Green Tourmaline carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Green Tourmaline is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Green Tourmaline have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Green Tourmaline, but if you find flaws, then your Green Tourmaline is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Green Tourmaline are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Green Tourmaline. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Green Tourmaline, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Green Tourmaline from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Green Tourmaline. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Green Tourmaline. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Green Tourmaline Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well.

The Green Tourmaline might carry negative energies routinely, the gemstone or the ornament in which it is fixed can be detoxified by dipping it in water overnight.

Exposure to heat or intense light should be avoided to avoid radiation-induced color changes.

Warm, soapy water is the most effective way to clean green tourmaline.

It is not advised to use ultrasonic and steam cleaners.
